source: SEC EDGAR browse-edgar SIC index + XBRL frames API
note: expected_active is the SIC cohort intersected with filers reporting ANY tracked concept in that period -- a liveness proxy, so thinness measures concept-level tagging shortfall among filers that were actually filing, not company mortality. The union (not one baseline concept) is what bounds thinness to [0,1): a single-concept denominator produced -50% on SIC 8700 CY2023Q4I.
